AI assistants can help, but nothing is more powerful than human spirit and determination. This toolkit exists to help you stay organized, stay focused, and stay strong when the system tries to overwhelm you.

Wolves shouldn’t fall like sheep — and neither should you.

Forseti gives you structure, clarity, and tools, but you are responsible for your actions, your filings, and your decisions. This app is here to support your strength, not replace it.
Asvaettir Labs \u2014 Tools for the Determined.

Brokkr Forge Process imports a whole folder and auto-routes every file into the Brokkr-Forge layout for this case. Image Ingestion lets you pick photos, PDFs, audio, or video to drop straight in. Rename files first (e.g. \"2024\u201103\u201112_motion_to_dismiss.pdf\" or \"exhibit_A_invoice.jpg\") so Forseti can classify them automatically — anything unclassified lands in 99_Inbox/ for you to move from Case Profile \u2192 Open case.
